resources.string: Keep your library and stats safe in your own cloud
Your playlists, likes, listening stats, recap, profile and settings, kept in your own cloud. Songs stay out, so backups stay small.
Sign in with your Dropbox account
Sign in with your Microsoft account
Nextcloud, pCloud, Koofr, a NAS and more
Not set up in this build
Finish signing in in your browser
There\'s no browser on this phone to sign in with.
Dropbox backup is still in testing. Only the first 500 people can connect, and Dropbox may stop new sign-ins sooner until it approves Mochy. If Dropbox won\'t let you in, WebDAV has no limit.
Stop backing up to %1$s. Backups already there stay.
Connected. Your backups go to %1$s now.

Bring your library, stats and settings back from the cloud
Runs in the background whenever there\'s a connection, and skips a turn when nothing changed
After each backup, this phone\'s oldest ones are deleted so only this many stay. Other phones\' backups are left alone.
Pick one. Your library, stats and settings are swapped for the ones in it, then Mochy restarts. Downloaded songs stay as they are.
Backups go into a Mochy Backups folder at this address. Your password stays on this phone and never goes into a backup.
